subject: Vulnerability management evidence and delivery plan - Crescent Bank RFP
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@crescentbank.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Crescent Bank Procurement <procurement@crescentbank.com>
Date: 2027-08-09T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: RFP follow-up: vulnerability management evidence and timelines

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the RFP submission last week. Procurement and security have a couple of clarifying questions on the vulnerability management (VM) deliverables before we move to scoring:

1) SBOM scope — do you provide a bill-of-materials for both runtime containers and third-party Python packages? We need a CSV export per environment.
2) SAST/DAST cadence — what frequency and which rule sets do you run (e.g., OWASP Top 10, CWE mapping)?
3) Pen test summary — can you provide a one-page executive summary and evidence of remediation items from the last vendor engagement?
4) Patch SLA — define your SLA windows for critical/high/medium security patches and the expected remediation timeline for customer-impacting issues.

Can you confirm what evidence you can provide and a realistic delivery date? Crescent needs the items to attach to the compliance appendix by Aug 20.

Regards,
Maria Lopez
Director, Third-Party Risk
Crescent Bank

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@crescentbank.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-09T11:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up: vulnerability management evidence and timelines

Maria —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front and then next steps:

- SBOM: yes — we can provide CSV exports for both runtime images and language/package manifests per deployment environment. I will attach a sample CSV and an index doc.
- SAST/DAST: SAST is run daily against main branches with rule sets aligned to CWE and internal criticality tiers; DAST is scheduled weekly against staging with OWASP Top 10 checks. We will provide a schedule and the rule-set mapping.
- Pen test summary: we have a two-page summary from the Q2 external assessment and an itemized remediation tracker; will attach summary and remediation snapshot.
- Patch SLA: our policy is Critical: 48 hours to mitigation plan and 14 days to resolution; High: 7 days; Medium: 30 days (non-production exceptions documented). I'll attach the SLA matrix.

Next steps: priyom will drop the detailed artifacts into the Drive folder and attach the key files here. Laura, looping you in for any commercial artifacts or formal attestation Crescent requires (SOC2 cross-reference, etc.).

Would you be available for a 30-minute call tomorrow to review the package before final delivery? If not, we can provide the files and a short written attestation.

Best,
Rishi
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@crescentbank.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-10T08:27:00-04:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up: vulnerability management evidence and timelines

Maria —

Following up with the technical package we discussed. Attached items (stubs listed below) have been uploaded to the shared Drive link in related_links. Delivery ETA: full package by EOD Aug 12 to give Crescent time to ingest before your Aug 20 deadline.

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood_sbom_2027-07.csv (SBOM export: runtime images, base images, pip/apt manifests; columns: component, version, checksum, environment, image_tag)
- pen_test_summary_q2_2027.pdf (Executive summary, scope, vendor: SkyShield Security, date: 2027-06-15, CVEs found grouped by severity, remediation status)
- patch_sla_matrix.xlsx (Defines SLA windows and remediation workflow, includes escalation steps and rollback procedures)
- redwood_vm_evidence_index.md (Index mapping each RFP question to artifact/URL)

Key technical clarifications:
1) SBOM scope: The CSV includes both built artifacts (container layers) and language-level manifests for the public Python packages we package into images. Private third-party binary deps are listed as placeholders with vendor identifiers. For full reproducibility we provide image digests and build recipe links.
2) SAST: We run nightly static scans using an internal fork of OSS scanners, tuned with CWE mapping. Critical findings are triaged to the Triage Queue and assigned within 24 hours. Exportable reports include vulnerability id, file path, severity, and remediation link.
3) DAST: Weekly authenticated scans against staging using OWASP Top 10 checks plus token replay. Results include request/response pairs and remediation suggestions.
4) Pen test: SkyShield executed a black-box + authenticated test. We remediated all Critical/High findings; the summary PDF lists remediation tickets, patch dates, and CVE references. Full remediation evidence (before/after diffs, PRs and Jira links) is included in the Drive folder.
5) Patch SLA: Critical — 48 hours to mitigation plan, 14 days to resolution or a documented compensating control; High — 7 calendar days; Medium — 30 calendar days. Emergency hotfix process: same-day escalation via on-call and a dedicated hotfix branch.

Compliance items: we can supply a SOC2 control mapping for release/change management on request and a short attestation letter signed by our Security Officer.

If you want, we can prepare a one-page attestation and a controlled export package for your review call. Proposed call times: Aug 11 between 9:00–11:00 AM ET.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

-- Attachment stubs referenced: redwood_sbom_2027-07.csv, pen_test_summary_q2_2027.pdf, patch_sla_matrix.xlsx, redwood_vm_evidence_index.md --
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@crescentbank.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Crescent Bank Procurement <procurement@crescentbank.com>
Date: 2027-08-11T14:42:00-04:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up: vulnerability management evidence and timelines

Thanks, Priyom and Rishi — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Two quick last items before we close the compliance appendix:

1) Please confirm final delivery date for the zipped evidence package (we will accept a Drive folder link).
2) Can you provide the short attestation letter you mentioned mapping your patch SLA to our risk matrix and confirming remediation evidence is available? That attestation can be a PDF signed by your security officer.

If those two items arrive by EOD Aug 12 we will consider the VM section complete. If a call is needed, we can accept Aug 11 10:00 AM ET; Maria to send calendar invite if confirmed.

Regards,
Maria Lopez
Director, Third-Party Risk
Crescent Bank
